   1 class_name EnemyAISystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 
   5 func setup() -> void:
   6 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   7 
   8 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
   9 	return q.with_all([C_EnemyAI, C_Transform, C_Health]).enabled()
  10 
  11 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  12 	for entity in entities:
  13 		if not entity.enabled:
  14 			continue
  15 		var ai: C_EnemyAI = entity.get_component(C_EnemyAI)
  16 		var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
  17 		var input: C_Input = entity.get_component(C_Input)
  18 		var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
  19 		input.sword_pressed = false
  20 		input.card_pressed = false
  21 		input.axis = 0.0
  22 		motion.desired_velocity = Vector2.ZERO
  23 		if health.dead or health.hurt_left > 0.0 or motion.placement_pending:
  24 			continue
  25 		var target: Entity = runtime.world.entity_id_registry.get(ai.target_id)
  26 		if not is_instance_valid(target) or not target.enabled or target.get_component(C_Health).dead:
  27 			continue
  28 		if target.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id != entity.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id:
  29 			continue
  30 		ai.time_left = maxf(0.0, ai.time_left - delta)
  31 		var position: Vector2 = entity.get_component(C_Transform).position
  32 		var target_position: Vector2 = target.get_component(C_Transform).position
  33 		var offset: Vector2 = target_position - position
  34 		if ai.kind == "flying":
  35 			offset.y -= 48.0
  36 		if ai.state in ["spawning", "recover"]:
  37 			if ai.time_left <= 0.0:
  38 				ai.state = "idle"
  39 			continue
  40 		if ai.state == "telegraph":
  41 			if ai.time_left <= 0.0:
  42 				if ai.kind == "ranged":
  43 					input.card_pressed = true
  44 				else:
  45 					input.sword_pressed = true
  46 				ai.state = "lunge" if ai.kind == "flying" else "recover"
  47 				ai.time_left = 0.32 if ai.kind == "flying" else 1.05
  48 			continue
  49 		if ai.state == "lunge":
  50 			motion.desired_velocity = Vector2(motion.facing * 360.0, 0.0)
  51 			if ai.time_left <= 0.0:
  52 				ai.state = "recover"
  53 				ai.time_left = 0.9
  54 			continue
  55 		if offset.length() > ai.aggro_range:
  56 			ai.state = "idle"
  57 			continue
  58 		input.axis = signf(offset.x)
  59 		if ai.kind == "ranged" and absf(offset.x) < 220.0:
  60 			ai.state = "retreat"
  61 			motion.desired_velocity.x = -signf(offset.x) * motion.speed
  62 			continue
  63 		var in_range: bool = absf(offset.x) <= ai.attack_range and absf(offset.y) < 75.0
  64 		if in_range:
  65 			ai.state = "telegraph"
  66 			ai.time_left = 0.65 if ai.kind == "ranged" else 0.5
  67 			runtime.request_spawn("effect", entity.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id, {"kind": "telegraph", "position": position + Vector2(0, -55), "size": Vector2(85, 100), "color": Color(1, 0.35, 0.48, 0.85), "duration": ai.time_left, "owner_id": entity.id})
  68 		else:
  69 			ai.state = "approach"
  70 			motion.desired_velocity = offset.normalized() * motion.speed if ai.kind == "flying" else Vector2(signf(offset.x) * motion.speed, 0)
